The Nazarene Theological Seminary of Peru is an evangelical institution dedicated to the preparation of Christian ministers, and are giving us kindly their facilities for the realization of the tournament, therefore, it is asked to have an appropriate behavior to the Religious Institute. We are allowed to use the place of ceremonies where the tournament will take place, go through the open spaces, and use the bathrooms. But it's forbidden to enter classrooms, offices and any other of the facilities.
